notes.title: Nekogumi Demo v1.03 & v1.04 Patch~
notes.notes:
[p]🛠️ Patch Notes – Demo Update v1.03 & v1.04[/p][p]26th September , 2025[/p][p]🔧 Improvements[/p][list][*][p]Added [b]camera distance adjustment[/b] to the options menu[/p][/*][*][p]Edited [b]demo end screen localization text[/b] for clarity across languages[/p][/*][/list][p]🐞 Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixing [b]camera system options [/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Remapped and fixed [b]manual buttons[/b] in the options menu[/p][/*][/list][p]💡 Player Tips & Feedback[/p][p]If the camera still feels a bit off, try adjusting the [b]camera distance[/b] in the settings menu to find what feels best for you.[/p][p]If you have further suggestions or run into issues, we encourage you to use the [b]bug report or feedback form[/b]—constructive input helps us improve the experience for everyone. We need your input to improve [b]Nekogumi[/b], so we hope to hear from you~[/p][p]💬 Dev Notes[/p][p]Hello human~[/p][p]Thanks again for all the feedback—yes, even a single bug report helps! As a solo developer, I read everything and try hard to make this game the best it can be. If you haven’t played the demo yet, now’s a great time. And if you enjoyed it, consider leaving a review—it helps more than you know.[/p][p]More updates coming soon!
— Ki-nodes Studio[/p]

notes.title: Nekogumi Demo v1.02 Patch~
notes.notes: [p]Hello human, [/p][p]Just a quick note to say thank you for wishlisting the game and checking out the demo. It’s been a week since our demo launch, and we’ve made some updates to camera and controls based on early feedback, hopefully things feel a bit…smoother now.[/p][p]As a solo developer, every bit of feedback—yes, even just one bug report—means a lot. I read everything, and I try hard to make this game the best it can be. [/p][p]If you haven’t played the demo yet, now’s a great time. And if you have, thank you for being part of this journey. Your support means the world. And if you enjoyed it, consider leaving a review - it helps more than you know.[/p][p]More updates coming soon![/p][p]Ki-nodes Studio[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtube.com/shorts/AyrkDJiaEOU?feature=share"][/dynamiclink][/p]
